title: Automate NCIC contradiction detection
description: Script that flags agencies in the scraper output exhibiting the Maass contradiction: those that both prohibit immigration enforcement in their policy AND subscribe to National and statewide hotlist sources (which include the NCIC Immigration Violator File). Also detect data-sharing chains to agencies like Everett/Lynnwood that don't prohibit immigration enforcement at all, since sharing data with them creates a backdoor for immigration enforcement.
notes:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Script runs against latest stats.jsonl and page.txt across all WA agencies
- Outputs report of agencies with the contradiction: prohibits immigration AND uses National/statewide hotlist sources
- Detects agencies sharing data with Everett/Lynnwood
- Results integrable into GitHub Pages or CI
